description:
FILED s411 (Fable) from docs/plan-one-compiler-s411.md Phase R.  FIRST item of the reordered queue (USER 2026-08-18: structural first, not at any cost).

WHAT: new Pl/Passes.pm with enabled($name) (Kind-A, facts-licensed emissions) and register_pass/run_passes (Kind-B, CLForm->CLForm; ordered; empty at first).  PCL_OPT=none | -name,+name,... parsed once at load.  Name and gate the FIVE existing Kind-A transforms at their emission sites: raw-numeric (VarAnnotator B verdict / native_root_write; today PCL_NO_RAW_VERDICT), str-buffer (S1, task #62), foreach-range (p-foreach-range, Parser2 ~8146), insensitive-call and elem-setf (both arrive with Phase A / #384 — gate them there).  run_passes at the ONE point a lowered top-level form is handed to the printer.  Design: docs/v2-target-architecture.md §3.

BAR: PCL_OPT unset -> tools/corpus-diff.pl IDENTICAL; PCL_OPT=none -> tools/prove-core AND the full sweep still pass (this is the first time all the general forms are exercised together — a failure here is a bug in a general path, fix it, do not weaken the flag); a Pl/t row per name asserting the flag changes emission (transpile-test-10.t or a new passes-01.t); whole-corpus transpile time unchanged (68.4 s at s411 on the dev machine).  Docs: DECIDED line, ir-spec if a macro name changes (none expected), CLAUDE.md Quick Reference gets PCL_OPT.

NOT in scope: any new optimization; #73/#74/#77 come later as Kind-B passes on this registry.

DONE s411 (Fable, same session as the plan): Pl/Passes.pm, PCL_OPT, four Kind-A gates (raw-slot raw-numeric str-buffer foreach-range), Pl::Passes::run at the four to_string handoffs, Pl/t/passes-01.t (22 rows), CLAUDE.md Quick Reference + raw-numeric-verdict.md updated.  Bars met: corpus-diff IDENTICAL; PCL_OPT=none gate = every RUN row passes (shape-assertion rows differ by definition: parser2-01/02, raw-verdict-01, clform-01, argv-01, writes-args-01, statements-01 5/7/28, lexical-sub-01 23, prototype-01 91); the flag found and the session fixed a default-config silent-wrong (%p-flatten-list snapshotting a magic cell / tie proxy â see DECIDED s411 + transpile-test-10.t guard).  insensitive-call + elem-setf gates arrive with #384.
